title: Books of Doom · The Burning Mask
question: Why did Doom put on the mask while it was still hot?

sources.title: Marvel · Doctor Doom: Books of Doom
sources.excerpt: Marvel's collection lists issues 1–6, Ed Brubaker and Pablo Raimondi, and Victor's journey from college to the throne of Latveria.

sources.title: Sideshow's licensed Marvel Doctor Doom catalog account
sources.excerpt: Victor wore the newly forged mask while it was red-hot and was permanently disfigured.

sources.title: TV Insider · Doctor Doom comics backstory
sources.excerpt: Victor was injured by an experiment and fled to Tibet, where monks helped make his mask and he developed his armor.

claims.text: Victor traveled to Tibet, where monks helped him craft his armor and mask.
Victor's college experiment exploded and left him with a facial scar.
Victor put on the mask while it was red-hot.
The heat of the mask disfigured Victor.
The iconic mask became part of Victor's identity as Doctor Doom.

notes: Public sources support the origin beat. Full comic pages were unavailable. The hammer, tongs, worried expression and visible cooling are symbolic staging for the preview. Use this recap as a reading companion to Books of Doom.
